notes.title: A Tithe in Blood is now released!
notes.content: [h3][i][b]Find unexpected love in the depths of grief...[/b][/i][/h3][p][/p][p]Our next yuri visual novel, A Tithe in Blood, is out now![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45043283/ba0432d4dc1ffbb328b9e960e2efeee1aa3d67fe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As a reserved and unassuming university student in snow-bitten Hokkaido, the personal tragedy which visited Honoka Asakawa leads her to experimenting in a magical art thought long-lost — blood magic. Unexpectedly able to visit the sealed world of Meiji-era Sapporo, Honoka's quickly taken under the wing of the cheerful and bright Lady Yasue, a powerful mage who's remained in this gilded cage for a century.[/p][p]As their feelings for each other develop, the true repercussions of Honoka's first steps into the secret world of magic and mages are only just starting to play out, eventually leading to catastrophic consequences.[/p][p][/p][h3]Features:[/h3][list][*][p]Original story of approximately 70,000 words[/p][/*][*][p]Concept and writing by Suriko[/p][/*][*][p]Character designs and art by Kobuta[/p][/*][*][p]Fully original soundtrack by Claire DeLuca[/p][/*][*][p]Fully voice acted in Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Story written in English with Japanese and Simplified Chinese translations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="1KsUQd2h3i8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]A Tithe in Blood also has an [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783570"]artbook available[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783570"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Get the physical copy of [/b][url="https://vnstudioelan.com/store/A-Tithe-in-Blood-Classic-Edition-p754767604"]the VN[/url][b] or [/b][url="https://vnstudioelan.com/store/A-Tithe-in-Blood-Official-Artbook-p754766080"]the artbook[/url][/p][p][/p][h1][i]follow us on...[/i][/h1][h3][url="https://bsky.app/profile/vnstudioelan.com" style="button"]Bluesky[/url]  -  [url="https://vnstudioelan.com/newsletter/" style="button"]Newsletter[/url]  -  [url="https://www.patreon.com/vnstudioelan" style="button"]Patreon[/url]  -  [url="https://discord.gg/dNZYDaGbh9" style="button"]Discord[/url][/h3]

Unexpectedly able to visit the sealed world of Meiji-era Sapporo, Honoka's quickly taken under the wing of the cheerful and bright Lady Yasue, a powerful mage who's remained in this gilded cage for a century.[/i][/p][p][i]As their feelings for each other develop, the true repercussions of Honoka's first steps into the secret world of magic and mages are only just starting to play out, eventually leading to catastrophic consequences.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Full game features:[/h3][list][*][p]Original story of approximately 70,000 words[/p][/*][*][p]Concept and writing by Suriko[/p][/*][*][p]Character designs and art by Kobuta[/p][/*][*][p]Fully original soundtrack by Claire DeLuca[/p][/*][*][p]Fully voice acted in Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Story written in English with Japanese and Simplified Chinese translations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="1KsUQd2h3i8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]You can also get the physical copy of [/b][url="https://vnstudioelan.com/store/A-Tithe-in-Blood-Classic-Edition-p754767604"]the VN[/url][b] or [/b][url="https://vnstudioelan.com/store/A-Tithe-in-Blood-Official-Artbook-p754766080"]the artbook[/url]![/p][p][/p][h1][i]follow us on...[/i][/h1][h3][url="https://bsky.app/profile/vnstudioelan.com" style="button"]Bluesky[/url]  -  [url="https://vnstudioelan.com/newsletter/" style="button"]Newsletter[/url]  -  [url="https://www.patreon.com/vnstudioelan" style="button"]Patreon[/url]  -  [url="https://discord.gg/dNZYDaGbh9" style="button"]Discord[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Announcing Full Japanese Translation & Voice Acting!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that our upcoming dark yuri visual novel A Tithe in Blood will launch with Japanese language support and full Japanese voice acting!

Studio Élanの新作百合ADVゲーム『A Tithe in Blood 〜血の契り〜』が、日本語対応と日本語フルボイスでリリース決定！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45043283/00c3d5a080547cb017106c25e2731b762ce227ab.png[/img]

notes.title: The Storyteller's Festival
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TwoHalfStudios/sale/TheStorytellersFestival2025]The Storyteller's Festival[/url] is happening now! This is a week-long Steam festival focused on visual novels and other story-driven games. There's over 400 games in the event—including a few of ours!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45043283/efdbd07e4403f3d30e2e77b42197a608ec9a78c1.png[/img]

Here's a few of our other LGBT+ yuri titles that are in the festival—give them a wishlist or check out their demos if you'd like to support us!

[b]Lock & Key: A Magical Girl Mystery[/b] is a mystery yuri visual novel about magical girls solving one last crime before their powers go away for good.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1803850/Lock__Key_A_Magical_Girl_Mystery/

[b]Summer at the Edge of the Universe[/b] is an LGBT+ yuri solarpunk adventure about the trip of a lifetime through the cosmos.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2641720/Summer_at_the_Edge_of_the_Universe/

[b]Our Home, My Keeper[/b] is a slice-of-life yuri romance about a burnt out writer and a fairy who might just help her out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3092190/Our_Home_My_Keeper/

[b]Please Be Happy[/b] is a comfy slice-of-life yuri romance about a traveling foxgirl and the pair of women she meets one fateful day in Wellington.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/844670/Please_Be_Happy/

[b]Twofold[/b] is an LGBT+ romance about a struggling nonbinary college student and the women who help them pass—but need help of their own.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1749770/Twofold/

We're also teaming up with several other visual novel developers to share the wide world of visual novels in the festival!
